capabilities: Sync the vault with Google Drive in two-way mirror, one-way backup, or historic archive modes
Reconcile Markdown conflicts using SHA-256 hashes across local, cloud, and last-synced states
Upload large files in chunks via resumable Google Drive sessions
Run background auto-sync on a configurable interval with mobile catch-up sync
Ignore selected folders and choose the remote vault folder in Drive
disambiguation: Despite the general-sounding name, it syncs only with Google Drive, not other cloud providers.
extras: The manifest carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice. Google Cloud apps left in 'Testing' status expire logins after about 7 days, requiring weekly re-login unless the app is formally verified. Credentials are stored in Obsidian SecretStorage since v1.1.0, but older settings backups may contain plaintext credentials.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault synchronized with Google Drive without a paid service or an intermediary server.

relations.evidence: All communication happens directly between your device and Google's servers using OAuth credentials you generate yourself

requires.name: Self-generated Google Cloud OAuth client ID and secret

summary: Google Drive synchronization engine that mirrors vault files directly to the user's own Drive account using self-generated OAuth credentials.
